results.note: CTP/ISW Iran Update of 27 Oct lists 'nothing significant to report' under US military operations; CNN (26 Oct) and others report only that CENTCOM has strike plans awaiting a Trump order, and no CENTCOM/White House/Pentagon confirmation of a strike on Iranian territory in the window was found (centcom.mil not checked directly).

CTP/ISW of 27 Oct reports Iran seeking Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish help to get Washington back to talks and a regional summit with 'no progress'; no Trump/White House announcement of an agreement confirmed by Iran or Qatar was found in the window.

ČTK (24 Oct) reports the Pirates will propose Okamura's recall at the next sitting of the Chamber, with no signatures collected yet; Pirates launched a public petition on 26 Oct (FeedIT). Searches of ČTK, iROZHLAS and other outlets found no report of a written proposal with 80 or more MPs' signatures being submitted on 26–27 Oct. This rests on the absence of any report; psp.cz was not checked directly.

On 27 Oct ombudsman Lubinets said 'a ceasefire came into effect today at 3 a.m. Kyiv time' and Budanov (head of the President's Office) confirmed it. The Russian Defence Ministry announced its forces had ceased fire around Oleshky, and the Russian General Staff said the regime took effect at 04:00 Moscow time (m24.ru, RIA).

As of 17:30 on 27 Oct Lubinets said 'no violations of the ceasefire have been recorded by either side', and Peskov said the Kremlin had received no reports of violations (m24.ru/RIA, 27 Oct). No accusation by either side was found later in the window. Late-evening Telegram channels were not checked exhaustively.

The vlada.gov.cz release of 27 Oct (14:58) lists four MoUs signed during the visit: geology, fire and civil protection, a business council and cinematography. Gas features only as a topic of talks, the Czech aim being to extend and double the ČEZ–Sonatrach contract. Algerian press (expressdz, 27 Oct) says the companies 'examinent' the extension. The Sonatrach–ČEZ extension found online dates from 16 Oct 2025.

No statement by Borissov or a GERB body backing Gyurov or calling for a vote for him on 26–27 Oct was found. BTA's 27 Oct media review and Fakti's 27 Oct news digest report other parties' runoff positions but no GERB endorsement. Gyurov said he would not seek support from party headquarters (bTV). gerb.bg was not checked directly.

Reports dated 27 Oct (Selectra; Yahoo/AFP-based piece at 20:55 CET) say an early rise from 1 Dec is only 'envisagée'. Labour minister Farandou reportedly floated about 1%, unions rejected it, and the government is expected to decide by 5 Nov. No decided increase was announced by 23:59 CET on 27 Oct.
Boeing's Q3 release of 27 Oct 2026 reports operating cash flow of $1,496 million and free cash flow (non-GAAP) of $464 million, which is positive.
Conference Board release of 27 Oct 2026: the index 'rose by 7.5 points to 91.7 (1985=100) in October, up from 84.2 in September'.
The same release gives October at 91.7 against a revised September of 84.2, so the index rose.

After the 24 Oct restoration (Zelensky said full Starlink/Starshield service had been restored), Ukrainian officials disputed Musk's claims of a breach of terms (24–25 Oct). No statement by a listed Ukrainian official on 26–27 Oct saying service had again been restricted was found in English or Ukrainian searches. This rests on the absence of any report.

After the 27 Oct talks (Deník and iROZHLAS around 13:20), Praha sobě accepted two council seats instead of three but had not confirmed joining. Scheinherr said the specific split of areas among the future councillors had not yet been discussed, the new property portfolio offer must go to his club, and the three meet again on Monday. No portfolio agreement or signing took place.

'Výsledky jednání vlády 26. října 2026' (vlada.gov.cz text republished by kurzy.cz), item 3: MPs Šťastný, Macinka, Okamura and Turek's draft constitutional amendment (sněmovní tisk 320) – 'schváleno souhlasné stanovisko'. ČTK ('Vláda podpořila návrh na ústavní zakotvení koruny') and SPD confirm this is the koruna bill.

Deník N (27 Oct, 17:13), Aktuálně.cz and TN.cz report with photos that Babiš and Fico unveiled the Czech–Slovak friendship statue together, in person, in the garden of the Strakova akademie on 27 Oct.

TSE docket not checked directly; O Povo (28 Oct, citing Folha) and Times Brasil (26 Oct) report Flávio dropped the annulment route, only announced an intended cassação action, and the PL recognised the result, with no annulment/recount filing at the TSE through 27 Oct.

No official channel announcement found; RFE/RL (26 Oct) said no PM candidate had been presented and N1 on the evening of 28 Oct still described Dejan Soskic only as a candidate on the list, with no PM announcement reported by N1 on 26-27 Oct.

The White House presidential-actions list shows tariff proclamations signed 22 Oct (wind turbines), 23 Oct (Canada scope) and 28 Oct (robotics/industrial machinery, 'twenty-eighth day of October') but none dated 26 or 27 Oct, and the Federal Register API returns no presidential documents signed on or after 24 Oct.
